name: Saimin Koukan
source:
"Takasato Mikiya"
Due to his timid nature, he is treated practically like a slave by his mother, Yurie, and younger sister, Kotomi.

One day...
Mikiya receives a letter from an unknown sender.
It is from his father, who was thought to be dead.

The sudden news comes as a surprise.
And the contents of the letter were...

His father possessed a supernatural power called "hypnotic power."
Every time it was activated, he suffered anguish and had no choice but to move repeatedly...
His mother, Yurie, could no longer bear the pressure.
She blamed herself for their divorce...
But Mikiya also possesses this power, and can activate it if he desires.
If you're going through a difficult time, why don't you come live with me?

It said.
After learning the whole story, Mikiya was skeptical, but after testing it on animals, he became convinced that he too possessed hypnotic powers.
And by continuing to train every day, he succeeds in fully awakening his powers.

Mikiya's powers have been awakened.
His next target was...
